text:
sophia: Heads-up — planned deploy tonight 01:00 UTC for llm-routing v4. Canary cohort will start at 5% in eu-west, then 25% after 15m, then 100% if green. route_v4 feature flag will be used for rollout and we'll pin model version v2.1.4 for the canary cohort.
sophia: Window is 01:00–02:00 UTC. Deploybot scheduled job ID: db-78934. Quiet window requested (no non-essential merges during the hour). :eyes:
deploybot: deploy scheduled by @sophia — job db-78934. Planned flag toggles: route_v4 -> 5% @01:00, 25% @01:15, 100% @01:30 (hold points at each step). Automated health gates enabled.
alex: Quick Q — are we pinning the model binary/version for the pinned cohort? last time hot-swap caused drift.
sophia: Yes, pinning to model_version=v2.1.4 for cohorts 0 & 1. We'll unpin at full rollout if ops ok. Pin done via runtime control-plane, not service restart.
chris: Metrics to watch: p95 latency, error-rate (5xx), kv cache miss rate, and tail memory OOMs. Thresholds we agreed on in the runbook: p95 > 250ms OR 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m -> rollback. Also watch token-per-second drop for any backpressure.
lee: Can we get the quick rollback command in this thread please so oncall has it handy? Also how do we revoke the pin if we need to revert model version?
sophia: Rollback commands:
```bash
# abort the deploy and force old flag
deploybot abort db-78934 --reason "rollback: high errors"
# immediate revert of feature flag
redwoodctl flags set route_v4 0 --note "emergency revert"
# unpin model from cohort
redwoodctl runtime unpin-cohort --cohort canary --service llm-routing
```
(ops, do not paste creds here) :lock:
deploybot: Noted. Automated rollback will trigger if health gate tripped. Manual abort accepted from users in group: deploys-admin, eng-oncall, release-leads.
alex: Suggest adding a soft-failover route to v3-backed pool for 1 minute on first failure to avoid bulk errors — do we have that play in the runbook? saves immediate rollback noise.
sophia: Good call. We'll enable transient fallback to v3 for up to 60s on first transient spike, then escalate to rollback if persistent. I'll add that to the job notes.
chris: Will monitor the slo dashboard and keep an eye on per-route token cost anomalies too (in case quantization path misaligned).
lee: I'm on pager for 00:45–02:15 UTC. If I see sustained p95 > 250ms I'll call abort and post the reason here.
sophia: Thanks — starting canary now at 01:00 UTC. I’ll post checkpoints at each hold point. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Canary started — cohort=5% (eu-west). Job db-78934 step=canary-start timestamp=1811112223. Health gates live.
